# dsh-sidebar-fold
Collapse the DSH sidebar's add-on entries into the shipped **“More”** row.

The left column's *Global panels* list grows with every installed plugin: schedules,
agent teams, th

e plugin market, context pages, … `dsh-sidebar-fold` puts a
**28×28 square arrow toggle** on the rig

ht end of the host's “More” row. One click
folds those add-on rows away so only the “More” line rema

ins; the arrow flips from
▲ (can collapse) to ▼ (can expand) and a second click brings the rows back

ns; the arrow flips from
▲ (can collapse) to ▼ (can expand) and a second click brings the rows back.

- **Non-invasive** — a client plugin that only adds DOM. The host bundle is never
patched, nothing i

n `app.asar` is touched, and uninstalling restores the sidebar
exactly as shipped (own `<style>` tag

and `data-dshsf-*` marks removed).
- **Structural header detection** — the header row is the `panel

Row` carrying
`aria-haspopup="menu"` inside the “Global panels” nav, which is locale-independent
and

independent of plugin registration order.
- **State per window** — the folded/open choice persists

in `localStorage`, so a
reload keeps it.
- **Alignment switch** — the managed rows (the “More” row i

ncluded) can put their
icon + label pair **left / centred / right**. At `right` the toggle mirrors t

o the
row's left end so it never covers the text; the override is a single
`justify-content` longhan

d and leaves the row's `display`/`gap`/height alone.
- **Configurable** — default state, the kept-vi

sible rows and the row alignment live
in the plugin's settings card (host `Config`, `.volatile()`, a

pplied without a
restart).
- **Rail-safe** — when the sidebar is collapsed to the 36 px icon rail th

e toggle is
removed and every row is shown again: no squeezing, no half-hidden state.
- **Quiet degr

adation** — if the host DOM drifts and the anchors are not found, the
plugin stays out of the way in

stead of breaking the sidebar (`dsh-sidebar-fold:
fold installed { mounted: false }` in the console
tells you it happened).

## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then add `dsh-sidebar-fold` to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list (or
enable the bundle in the

app) and restart. On the desktop profile, quit the Electron
app before editing its `package.json` —

the running app rewrites that file and rolls
external edits back.
## Settings

Open **Plugins → dsh-sidebar-fold** (the card is registered on the
`plugins.bundle.config` seat, key
ed by the package name):
| Field | Meaning | Default |

| Folded by default | State a window starts in when it has no local record | off |
| Row alignment |
Three-way segmented control (left / centre / right) for the managed rows; the “More” row follows th

e same setting | left |
| Entries kept visible | **One switch per row read from the live sidebar** —
switch a row on to keep it visible while the rest fold | only `插件` / `Plugins` |

The row list is read from the DOM at open time, so a panel installed later shows up
without editing

anything. When every row is switched on the toggle dims itself and
reports `aria-disabled="true"` in
stead of flipping an arrow over an unchanged list.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`prepack` runs build + verify, so a stale `lib/client.js` cannot be published.
## Supported hosts

**DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 only.** Single source of truth: `scripts/hosts.mjs` (the three
declarations — `engi

nes.dsh`, `peerDependencies`, `dsh.plugin.json` — are generated
from it and must not be edited by ha

dsh`, `peerDependencies`, `dsh.plugin.json` — are generated
from it and must not be edited by hand).

Why not wider: mounting needs the sidebar's panel list **and** the shipped "More"
row. Measured on e
very published `dsh-client-ui-sidebar` rc:
| host line | panel list | "More" row |

On a line without the More row the plugin degrades quietly — it injects nothing and
leaves the sideb

ar as shipped. Declaring such a host would only install a plugin
that does nothing.

After a host upgrade, re-run the browser smoke test before widening this list:
CSS-module hashes dri

ft every build (rc.2 emitted `wtg9ga_`, rc.3 emits `hHd-Xa_`),
so only the fragment selectors (`_pan

elList`, `_panelRow`, `_moreAnchor`,
`_collapsed`) are stable.
## Upgrade guardrail

Host CSS-module hashes drift per build (`wtg9ga_` on rc.2 → `hHd-Xa_` on the rc.3
runtime), which is

why every selector matches a *fragment* (`_panelList`, `_panelRow`,
`_moreAnchor`, `_collapsed`). *

*After any host upgrade, re-run the browser smoke**
before assuming the fold still mounts; the plugi

n degrades silently by design, so a
regression shows up as “nothing happened”, not as an error.
